_comment: Persistent line membership (#819: persistent line membership state, the first of the deferred items docs/acies-triplex-design.md tracks under #819): four player Spearmen units spawn already spaced out just above the drag line, get box-selected, then a right-to-left checkerboard drag (form_up_dist=4, CHECKERBOARD) splits them into a front line and an offset rear line. That interaction is exactly where Unit.line_index gets stamped -- SelectionManager._checkerboard_slices tags each slice's line, Battle.enqueue_form_up carries it through, and Battle._apply_order_cmd writes it onto the unit (scripts/Battle.gd, scripts/SelectionManager.gd, scripts/Unit.gd). The persistent line state itself has no render path yet (this slice of #819 is bookkeeping only -- the flank-vulnerability and century-withdrawal mechanics that will read it are still to come), so this clip shows the visible half of the interaction (the checkerboard deploy) and the line-index bookkeeping it exercises is verified separately by test/unit/test_acies_triplex_line_membership.gd, test_battle.gd's line-index cases, and test_unit_card_tray.gd's line-index cases -- not by anything in this recording. drill:true (no team 1) since this is a pure maneuver demo. Static wide camera covering the whole spawn-to-settle span, no easing.

path_crossing.reason: Soldier paths transiently intersect while the multi-unit line splits into front/rear checkerboard positions before forming up.

overlap.reason: Each unit reforms in place from its spawn line into its checkerboard front/rear slot, and bodies converging on their new slots pass close to each other mid-transition before settling back to resting spacing. Since the same-unit standoff runs in a reform hold while any man stands more than a file pitch off his slot, the closest pairs read 1.89, 1.68, 1.67 and 0.51 wu for uids 0 to 3 on every seed (0.04, 0.04, 0.04 and 0.07 on main) against the 2.25 wu floor, and the blob verdict once exempted here passes on every seed. Traced on seed 0: uids 0 to 2 come closest at ticks 260, 278 and 278 in their REFORM hold, men a mean 30 wu off their slots, where the pass runs but pushes apart no faster than its bounded speed; uid 3 comes closest at tick 924, still holding, with every man within a file pitch of his slot (the pair 6.9 and 2.3 wu off theirs), where the hold skips the pass. Men of one block passing under the overlap floor in a REFORM hold is #1921. Measured 2026-11-04 on 47428369 against main bec0b16e with full state dumps every 2 ticks, every exemption removed, seeds 0 to 4.
